Royal Antwerp Football Club, commonly referred to as Royal Antwerp or simply Antwerp, is a Belgian professional football club based in the city of Antwerp. The team competes in the Belgian Pro League, the top tier of the Belgian football league system. Founded in 1880, it is the oldest football club in Belgium.
